question_text: A 16-year-old girl wants to access reproductive health services, including contraceptives, without parental consent. Under RA 10354 (Responsible Parenthood and Reproductive Health Act), which of the following is correct?

options.text: She cannot access any reproductive health services without parental consent.
She can access reproductive health services, but only if she is married.
She can access reproductive health services, including contraceptives, without parental consent.
She can access only information, but not contraceptives, without parental consent.
